label: Exact restore
definition: The same object identity and session state can be restored without translation.

label: Compatible restore
definition: The same object identity can be restored after a declared compatible translation or rebind.

label: Layout only
definition: Window, pane, or editor layout can be restored, but live session state cannot.

label: Recovered drafts
definition: Dirty buffers or drafts can be recovered without claiming a full session restore.

label: Evidence only
definition: Evidence can be exported or inspected, but not replayed as active state.

label: No restore
definition: No restorable state is available for this entry.
